subject.title: auth.order ignored for GitHub Copilot provider — first profile in auth.profiles always wins

question: Should maintainers adopt/replace the open fork PR that references this issue, or close that candidate and allow a fresh upstream fix PR for the Copilot auth-order helper?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and the fix shape is clear, but an open conflicting fork PR already claims this issue, so automation should not queue a competing fix until maintainers decide the landing path.

options.title: Replace with narrow upstream fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR and land a focused upstream patch in the Copilot auth helper/provider-auth seam with regression coverage.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR
options.body: Ask maintainers to rebase and review the fork PR if they want to preserve that branch as the candidate implementation.

options.title: Leave issue tracking only
options.body: Keep this issue open without a repair lane until a maintainer explicitly sponsors a fix path.

recommendation.title: Replace with narrow upstream fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR and land a focused upstream patch in the Copilot auth helper/provider-auth seam with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor merged the current Copilot helper extraction and has recent auth-order/provider-auth history, making them a strong routing owner for choosing the landing path.
